name: AI Interaction Atlas
summary: Open-source taxonomy and pattern reference for AI interaction design, with 100+ patterns across AI tasks, human actions and system ops.
description: An open-source taxonomy and reference site by quietloudlab that gives teams a shared language for designing AI experiences. Interactions are organised into six dimensions — AI tasks (classify, generate, verify), human tasks (review, approve, edit, compare), system tasks (routing, logging, state), data artifacts, constraints (latency, privacy, cost, accuracy) and touchpoints (UI, API, notifications, integrations) — with 100+ patterns, visual examples and reusable components. The Atlas data ships as a React/TypeScript codebase and an npm package (@quietloudlab/ai-interaction-atlas).
contains: 100+ interaction patterns across AI tasks, human actions and system ops
six dimensions: AI tasks, human tasks, system tasks, data artifacts, constraints, touchpoints
open source under Apache-2.0 (123 GitHub stars)
